title: Selection Bounds For Diagram And Scene
description: Add matching transparent axis-aligned selection bounds: SVG rect in ComposeDiagram, 3D box in ComposeScene, shared opacity/accent styling.
summary: Added shared selection overlay styling (COMPOSE_SELECTION_BOUNDS_FILL_OPACITY / STROKE_OPACITY on var(--accent)). ComposeDiagram draws an SVG rect under edges/nodes from selected pieces and connections. ComposeScene builds an axis-aligned Box3 from piece world anchors and connection endpoints, renders SceneSelectionBounds (transparent box + Edges) behind scene content. Extended vitests for computeDiagramSelectionOverlayRect and buildSceneSelectionBoundsBox. All compose/ui vitest tests pass.
